author: claude
content: Evaluate 4 models for the deception detection study — 2 closed-weight (GPT gpt-5.5, Claude claude-opus-4-8) and 2 open-weight (Llama 3.3 70B, Qwen 2.5 72B Instruct); closed models chosen as the latest flagship releases from two top providers, open models chosen for reasonable compute requirements given limited GPU access.
